description: This file defines the 'First' operator class in the OpenMRS reporting framework, which returns a subset of results from a criteria according to the specified number of top elements.

classes.name: First
classes.description: A class implementing the TransformOperator interface, representing an operator that retrieves the first N elements of a result set.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the operator, which is 'FIRST'.
